editorial.blurb: Takie Outit serves thoughtfully prepared Chinese classics made fresh to order, where the owner personally ensures every dish strikes the right balance of flavor and health.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the owner Nathan about their more popular dishes rather than milder options—he's known for inviting guests to try the standout preparations like Mongolian Beef and Kung Pao Chicken, and they'll customize seasoning to your preference since everything is made from scratch.
